title: Adopt eneo-module-kit in speech-to-text
description:
## Read first
- `docs/plans/2026-10-01-module-platform-design.md`: section 8 ("Honest limit": the kit's API is provisional until this adoption has happened).
- The kit's README and changelog in `eneo-ai/eneo-module-kit`.

## Scope
This repository, on a branch `feat/adopt-module-kit`: replace the shared code with imports from the packages. `frontend/kit/`, the shared parts of `backend/app/module_auth.py`, `config.py` and `main.py`, dependency files, Dockerfile.

## Out of scope
- Changing behaviour. Moving speech-to-text's own allowlist, live relay, recording, transcript or draft code into the kit.
- Starting before Plan A's last bead is closed and the kit has a released version.
- `backend/` and everything under `frontend/lib/` except the test files named in Scope.
- Screens and components that belong to another bead.
- Gate thresholds, gate states, axe exclusions, and the Astryx versions (exact pins).
- Ejecting ("swizzling") an Astryx component, authoring StyleX, adding Tailwind classes.
- Plan B (removing Next.js) and Plan C (the module kit).
- If something outside this scope looks wrong, write a comment on this bead (`br comments add`) and leave it alone.

## Steps
1. Write a short adoption plan (which file is replaced by which import) and have it reviewed.
2. Backend: depend on `eneo-module-bff`; `main.py` creates the app from the factory and declares this module's
   allowlist and its live relay. Backend tests pass unchanged.
3. Frontend: depend on `@eneo-ai/module-kit`; delete `frontend/kit/` and the session screens the package now owns.
4. Report every place the kit's API did not fit as an issue in the kit's repository.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Backend tests, unit tests, the whole gate, `test:prod` and the Docker build pass.
- No copy of code that the packages own remains in this repository.
- The kit's gaps found here are filed in its repository.

## Verify
```bash
cd backend && .venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s tests
cd ../frontend && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:a11y && npm run test:prod
```

## If blocked
Stop and comment on this bead instead of working around it when: a step's expected result does not appear after
one honest attempt to fix the cause; a stop condition in the plan ("Stop conditions") holds; or the task seems to
need a change outside Scope.
